title: Learning How Much to Collaborate: Difficulty-Aware Topology Selection for Multi-Agent Code Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.13890v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-agent systems for code generation are deployed with a single communication topology, chosen once for every problem. This is the wrong granularity. Evaluating five topologies on 614 problems from APPS, HumanEval+ and LiveCodeBench, we find that the advantage of hierarchical collaboration over a single agent grows from 2.4 points of pass@1 on the easiest third of problems to 21.1 points on the hardest third, while its token cost stays about ten times higher. We propose the Difficulty-Aware Topology Selector (DATS), which predicts each topology's probability of solving a problem and selects the one maximising predicted success minus cost. Its predictor is a graph network that treats the five topologies as nodes of a connectivity order rather than independent labels, worth 1.7 points over a flat multi-label head. translated_title: 学习协作的程度：面向多智能体代码生成的难度感知拓扑选择
translated_abstract: 用于代码生成的多智能体系统通常部署时采用单一的通信拓扑结构，即为所有问题一次性选定。这样的粒度是错误的。我们在来自 APPS、HumanEval+ 和 LiveCodeBench 的 614 个问题上评估了五种拓扑结构，发现层级协作相较于单智能体的优势从最简单三分之一问题上的 2.4 个 pass@1 点增长到最难三分之一问题上的 21.1 个点，而其 token 成本始终保持约十倍之高。我们提出了难度感知拓扑选择器（DATS），它预测每种拓扑解决某个问题的概率，并选择使预测成功率减去成本后最大化的拓扑。其预测器是一个图网络，将五种拓扑视为连接程度排序上的节点而非相互独立的标签，这一设计比平铺的多标签头高出 1.7 个点。由于成本惩罚是一个无需重新训练即可重新校准的单一标量，路由器可以在相同开销下进行比较：在这一机制下……
tldr: 提出难度感知拓扑选择器DATS，通过图网络预测各协作拓扑的解题概率并动态权衡成功率与token成本，使简单问题节省约十倍开销、困难问题最高提升21.1个pass@1点。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes DATS, a difficulty-aware topology selector that uses a graph network to predict each multi-agent topology's solve probability and dynamically balances predicted success against token cost, saving roughly 10x cost on easy problems while gaining up to 21.1 points of pass@1 on hard ones.
